_about: E. Nesbit's (Edith Nesbit, 1858-1924) books: the Bastable and Psammead books, The Railway Children, the Arden books and the other children's fantasies, the fairy-tale and dragon collections, her Shakespeare retellings and Royal Children, and the adult novels, stories and verse on Gutenberg. Collaborations name the partner. Clean Gutenberg text; all published before 1930: US public domain (and she died in 1924, so public domain nearly everywhere).

nesbit-story-of-the-treasure-seekers: The Story of the Treasure Seekers (1899)
nesbit-wonderful-garden: The Wonderful Garden; or, The Three Cs (1911)
nesbit-all-round-the-year: All Round the Year (1888), verses with Caris Brooke
nesbit-prophets-mantle: The Prophet's Mantle (1885), with Hubert Bland, as Fabian Bland
nesbit-wings-and-the-child: Wings and the Child; or, The Building of Magic Cities (1913)
